title: 微影晶圓台精密定位~Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages
focus: 掃描同步、Abbe 原理、Lorentz 致動、干涉儀與光柵量測、伺服前饋與套刻預算~Scan synchronisation, Abbe principle, Lorentz actuation, interferometer and grating metrology, servo feedforward and overlay budgets
summary: 以步進掃描微影機的雙台晶圓台為對象：先建立光罩台與晶圓台 4:1 同步掃描的 MA/MSD 誤差定義與 Abbe 原理，再拆解長短行程 Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量、雷射干涉儀與二維光柵編碼器的解析度與空氣折射率限制，接著以伺服頻寬、前饋精度、校正圖與隔振傳遞率建立奈米級誤差預算，最後整合成產能與套刻驗收記錄。~Taking the dual wafer stage of a step-and-scan lithography system as the object, the course first defines the MA/MSD errors of 4:1 synchronised reticle and wafer scanning and the Abbe principle, then dissects long- and short-stroke Lorentz actuators with balance masses, the resolution and air-index limits of laser interferometers and two-dimensional grating encoders, builds a nanometre error budget from servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy, calibration maps and isolation transmissibility, and closes with a throughput and overlay acceptance record.

units.anchor: 曝光縫隙與同步掃描~Exposure slit and synchronised scanning
units.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義~Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan
units.mechanism: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。晶圓上任一點在縫隙通過期間累積曝光，所以位置誤差的影響分成兩類：這段時間的平均誤差（MA）直接變成套刻誤差，而誤差的移動標準差（MSD）讓影像模糊、降低對比與 CD 均勻性。因此規格不是單一的定位精度，而是對掃描時間窗平均後的 MA 與 MSD。~A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. Any wafer point accumulates exposure while the slit passes, so position error acts in two ways: its average over that window (MA) becomes overlay error, while its moving standard deviation (MSD) blurs the image and degrades contrast and CD uniformity. The specification is therefore not a single positioning accuracy but MA and MSD averaged over the scan time window.
units.model: 晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。~At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window.
units.verify: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。~Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns.
units.failure: 掃描方向的加速段若未完全穩定就進入曝光，場的起始端會留下系統性的 MA 偏移與較高的 MSD，表現為每個場上緣的套刻偏差與線寬粗糙，而靜態定位測試完全看不出來。~If exposure starts before the acceleration phase has fully settled, the leading edge of every field carries a systematic MA offset and elevated MSD, seen as overlay deviation and rougher linewidth along one field edge, something a static positioning test never reveals.
units.misconception: 晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。~The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy.

units.anchor: 計量框架與 Abbe 偏置~Metrology frame and Abbe offset
units.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架~The Abbe principle and the metrology frame
units.mechanism: Abbe 原理要求量測軸與被量測點共線，否則載台的微小旋轉會乘上偏置距離變成位置誤差。晶圓表面與干涉儀光束或編碼器讀頭之間總有數毫米的垂直偏置，所以晶圓台必須同時量測六個自由度，用俯仰與偏擺角把 Abbe 誤差算回去。所有量測都參照一個由 Zerodur 或碳化矽製成、與機架隔振的計量框架，投影鏡頭與感測器固定其上，使位置量測的參考零點與影像位置共用同一剛體。~The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error. There is always a vertical offset of several millimetres between the wafer surface and the interferometer beams or encoder heads, so the wafer stage must be measured in all six degrees of freedom and the pitch and yaw angles used to compute the Abbe error back out. Every measurement refers to a metrology frame made of Zerodur or silicon carbide and isolated from the base frame; the projection lens and sensors are mounted on it so the position reference and the image share one rigid body.
units.model: Abbe 誤差 = 偏置 × 旋轉角：偏置 5 mm、載台俯仰 0.2 µrad 時誤差 = 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm；若角度量測解析度為 0.05 µrad，殘餘 Abbe 誤差可壓到 0.25 nm。計量框架若在 1 m 跨距上有 10 nm 的熱變形，對應 0.01 µrad 的參考傾斜，在 300 mm 晶圓邊緣造成 1.5 nm 的位置偏差。~Abbe error = offset × rotation: with a 5 mm offset and 0.2 µrad of stage pitch the error is 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm; with an angular measurement resolution of 0.05 µrad the residual Abbe error falls to 0.25 nm. A thermal deformation of 10 nm over a 1 m span of the metrology frame equals a 0.01 µrad reference tilt, which displaces positions by 1.5 nm at the edge of a 300 mm wafer.
units.verify: 刻意讓載台在固定 XY 位置上做已知的俯仰與偏擺微動，記錄 XY 讀值的變化，擬合出實際的 Abbe 偏置距離並與機械設計值比較；再以放在晶圓位置的參考標記對準量測，確認補償後的殘差小於預算值。~Command known small pitch and yaw motions at a fixed XY position, record the resulting XY readings, fit the actual Abbe offset distance and compare it with the mechanical design value; then measure alignment on a reference mark at wafer height to confirm that the compensated residual stays below budget.
units.failure: 晶圓夾盤更換後晶圓表面高度改變 0.5 mm，若軟體仍用舊的 Abbe 偏置，每 1 µrad 的載台旋轉就多出 0.5 nm 的未補償誤差，套刻在場與場之間出現與旋轉相關的系統性圖案。~After a chuck exchange raises the wafer surface by 0.5 mm, software still using the old Abbe offset leaves 0.5 nm of uncompensated error per microradian of stage rotation, and overlay shows a rotation-correlated systematic pattern from field to field.
units.misconception: 只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。~With straight enough guideways, rotation errors can be ignored.

units.anchor: Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量~Lorentz actuators and balance mass
units.title: 長短行程致動與反作用力管理~Long- and short-stroke actuation and reaction-force management
units.mechanism: 晶圓台採雙層結構：長行程台以線性或平面馬達在整片晶圓範圍移動，精度在微米級；短行程台以六組 Lorentz 致動器相對長行程台做毫米級行程的六自由度微動，達到奈米級。Lorentz 致動器力與電流成正比且無接觸、無磁滯，重力由永磁補償器承擔以減少發熱。加速時的反作用力若傳到機架會激發振動，所以馬達定子裝在可自由滑動的平衡質量上，動量守恆讓反作用力留在平衡質量而不進入計量框架。~The wafer stage is a two-layer system: a long-stroke stage driven by linear or planar motors covers the whole wafer at micrometre accuracy, while a short-stroke stage rides on it with six Lorentz actuators providing millimetre-range six-degree-of-freedom fine motion at nanometre level. Lorentz actuators give force proportional to current without contact or hysteresis, and a permanent-magnet gravity compensator carries the weight to limit heating. Reaction forces during acceleration would excite the frame, so the motor stators sit on a freely sliding balance mass, and momentum conservation keeps the reaction in the balance mass instead of the metrology frame.
units.model: 短行程台 20 kg 以 20 m/s² 加速需 F = 400 N；馬達力常數 40 N/A 時電流 10 A，線圈電阻 2 Ω 的瞬時銅損 I²R = 200 W，必須水冷。平衡質量 400 kg 時，載台掃描 33 mm 使平衡質量反向移動 (20/400)×33 = 1.65 mm，傳到機架的只剩導軌摩擦與纜線拖曳的殘餘力。~A 20 kg short-stroke stage accelerating at 20 m/s² needs F = 400 N; with a motor force constant of 40 N/A the current is 10 A, and a 2 Ω coil dissipates I²R = 200 W during the pulse, which requires water cooling. With a 400 kg balance mass a 33 mm stage scan moves the balance mass (20/400)×33 = 1.65 mm the other way, and only residual guide friction and cable drag reach the frame.
units.verify: 在馬達線圈上裝溫度感測器並以熱像儀記錄加速循環中的溫升，與 I²R 估計值比較；用加速度計量測機架在掃描循環中的振動頻譜，比較有無平衡質量的差異，確認反作用力隔離達到預期的數量級。~Fit temperature sensors on the motor coils and record the temperature rise with a thermal camera during acceleration cycles, comparing with the I²R estimate; measure the frame vibration spectrum with accelerometers during scan cycles with and without the balance mass to confirm the expected order of reaction-force isolation.
units.failure: 線圈發熱若未被完全帶走，短行程台的局部溫升使金屬結構膨脹並改變感測器到晶圓的距離，表現為曝光批次中套刻隨時間緩慢漂移，待機冷卻後又恢復。~If coil heat is not fully removed, local warming of the short-stroke stage expands the metal structure and shifts the sensor-to-wafer distance, seen as overlay drifting slowly within a lot and recovering after idle cooling.
units.misconception: 致動器力量越大，定位就越精準。~Stronger actuators give more precise positioning.

units.anchor: 雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器~Laser interferometer and grating encoder
units.title: 干涉儀解析度、空氣折射率與光柵量測~Interferometer resolution, air index and grating metrology
units.mechanism: 傳統晶圓台以 HeNe 雷射外差干涉儀量測位置：平面鏡雙程架構使每條干涉條紋對應四分之一波長，再由相位內插得到次奈米解析度。它的弱點是光束在空氣中走過數百毫米，空氣折射率隨溫度、壓力與濕度變化，死程誤差與擾流成為主要誤差源。近代機台改用固定在計量框架下方的二維光柵板與載台上的編碼器讀頭，空氣光程縮短到毫米級，對環境的靈敏度下降兩個數量級，代價是光柵板本身的圖樣誤差必須被校正。~Conventional wafer stages are measured with HeNe heterodyne laser interferometers: a double-pass plane-mirror configuration makes each fringe correspond to a quarter wavelength, and phase interpolation yields sub-nanometre resolution. Their weakness is the beam path of several hundred millimetres through air, whose refractive index varies with temperature, pressure and humidity, so dead-path error and turbulence dominate. Modern systems instead use two-dimensional grating plates fixed under the metrology frame with encoder heads on the stage, shrinking the air path to millimetres and cutting environmental sensitivity by two orders of magnitude, at the cost of having to calibrate the grating pattern itself.
units.model: HeNe λ = 632.8 nm 雙程干涉儀每條紋 λ/4 = 158.2 nm，4096 倍相位內插得 0.039 nm 解析度；但空氣 dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，死程 300 mm 遇到 10 mK 溫度變化就產生 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm 誤差。光柵編碼器的空氣間隙約 3 mm，同樣 10 mK 只造成 0.028 nm。~A HeNe λ = 632.8 nm double-pass interferometer has λ/4 = 158.2 nm per fringe and 4096-fold phase interpolation gives 0.039 nm resolution; but air has dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, so a 300 mm dead path with a 10 mK temperature change produces 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm of error. A grating encoder with a 3 mm air gap suffers only 0.028 nm for the same 10 mK.
units.verify: 讓載台靜止並連續記錄干涉儀或編碼器讀值數分鐘，計算 Allan 偏差隨平均時間的曲線，區分白雜訊、空氣擾流與熱漂移；再以溫度、壓力感測器同步記錄，用 Edlén 公式修正後比較殘差是否下降到預期量級。~Hold the stage still and log the interferometer or encoder reading for several minutes, compute the Allan deviation versus averaging time to separate white noise, air turbulence and thermal drift; log temperature and pressure simultaneously, apply the Edlén correction and check that the residual falls to the expected level.
units.failure: 干涉儀光路若有局部熱源造成空氣擾流，位置雜訊在 1 到 10 Hz 出現數奈米的隨機漂移，伺服系統會忠實跟隨這個假訊號而讓載台真的抖動，MSD 超標。~A local heat source in an interferometer beam path produces air turbulence with several nanometres of random drift between 1 and 10 Hz, the servo faithfully follows this false signal so the stage really shakes, and MSD exceeds specification.
units.misconception: 干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。~An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy.

units.anchor: 伺服迴路與前饋控制~Servo loop and feedforward control
units.title: 伺服頻寬、前饋精度與結構共振~Servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy and structural resonance
units.mechanism: 載台位置迴路通常用 PID 加上陷波濾波器，交越頻率在數百赫茲；更高的頻寬會被載台本體的第一個結構共振限制，經驗上共振頻率要高於頻寬的三到五倍，因此載台用碳化矽或陶瓷等高比剛度材料。掃描時的追蹤誤差主要不是靠回授壓低，而是用加速度前饋：把參考軌跡的加速度乘上質量直接送到致動器，回授只處理前饋的殘差與擾動。前饋的質量與延遲若估錯，殘差就直接以加速度為比例出現。~The stage position loop is typically PID with notch filters and a crossover of a few hundred hertz; higher bandwidth is limited by the first structural resonance of the stage body, which by experience must lie three to five times above the bandwidth, hence stage bodies of silicon carbide or ceramics with high specific stiffness. Tracking error during scanning is suppressed mainly by acceleration feedforward rather than feedback: the reference trajectory's acceleration times the mass is sent straight to the actuators and the loop handles only feedforward residuals and disturbances. A wrong mass or delay in the feedforward produces an error proportional to acceleration.
units.model: 雙積分受控體在恆定加速度下的穩態誤差 e ≈ a/ω_c²：a = 20 m/s²、交越頻率 300 Hz（ω_c = 1885 rad/s）時 e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm；若前饋把 99.9% 的加速力提供出來，剩餘誤差為 5.6 nm。頻寬 300 Hz 要求第一共振高於約 1.5 kHz；整定時間常數 1/ω_c ≈ 0.53 ms，從 1 µm 收斂到 1 nm 需 ln(1000)×0.53 ≈ 3.7 ms。~A double-integrator plant under constant acceleration has steady-state error e ≈ a/ω_c²: with a = 20 m/s² and a 300 Hz crossover (ω_c = 1885 rad/s), e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm; if feedforward supplies 99.9% of the acceleration force, the remaining error is 5.6 nm. A 300 Hz bandwidth requires the first resonance above about 1.5 kHz; the settling time constant 1/ω_c ≈ 0.53 ms means converging from 1 µm to 1 nm takes ln(1000)×0.53 ≈ 3.7 ms.
units.verify: 量測開迴路頻率響應（Bode 圖）確認增益交越、相位餘裕與共振位置；執行標準掃描軌跡並記錄誤差，分別關閉與開啟前饋比較誤差量級，再微調前饋質量與延遲參數直到加速段的殘差不再與加速度成比例。~Measure the open-loop frequency response (Bode plot) to confirm gain crossover, phase margin and resonance locations; run the standard scan trajectory and log the error with feedforward off and on to compare magnitudes, then tune the feedforward mass and delay until the residual during acceleration no longer scales with acceleration.
units.failure: 纜線拖鏈或冷卻水管的剛度隨位置改變，使受控體在某些位置多出一個低頻共振，固定的陷波濾波器失效，載台在特定場位置出現數十赫茲的極限環振盪與 MSD 尖峰。~Cable carriers or coolant hoses whose stiffness varies with position add a low-frequency resonance at certain locations, the fixed notch filters no longer match, and the stage shows limit-cycle oscillation of tens of hertz with MSD spikes at specific field positions.
units.misconception: 提高伺服增益就能消除掃描時的追蹤誤差。~Raising the servo gain removes scan tracking error.

units.anchor: 校正圖與誤差預算表~Calibration maps and error-budget table
units.title: 載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算~Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget
units.mechanism: 量測系統本身有系統性誤差：干涉儀反射鏡的平面度、光柵板的圖樣誤差、讀頭之間的非正交性與比例誤差，都要用自校正或交叉比對建成校正圖並在控制器中即時扣除。MA 誤差直接進入套刻預算，而 MSD 則像高斯模糊降低影像對比，對小間距的影響最大。誤差預算表把量測、致動、熱與振動的各項以均方根合成，並區分可校正的系統項與不可校正的隨機項。~The measurement system has systematic errors of its own: flatness of interferometer mirrors, pattern errors of the grating plate, non-orthogonality and scale errors between heads, all of which must be captured by self-calibration or cross-comparison into calibration maps subtracted in real time by the controller. MA error enters the overlay budget directly, while MSD acts like a Gaussian blur that reduces image contrast, most severely at small pitch. The error-budget table combines measurement, actuation, thermal and vibration terms in quadrature and separates correctable systematic terms from uncorrectable random ones.
units.model: MSD = 3 nm 對週期 80 nm 線條的對比因子為 exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973，即損失 2.7%。MA 預算：編碼器校正殘差 0.4 nm、Abbe 補償殘差 0.3 nm、伺服 MA 0.5 nm、熱漂移 0.4 nm、光柵圖樣殘差 0.3 nm，RSS = √(0.16+0.09+0.25+0.16+0.09) = √0.75 ≈ 0.87 nm。~An MSD of 3 nm gives a contrast factor for 80 nm pitch lines of exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973, a 2.7% loss. MA budget: encoder calibration residual 0.4 nm, Abbe compensation residual 0.3 nm, servo MA 0.5 nm, thermal drift 0.4 nm and grating pattern residual 0.3 nm give RSS = √(0.16+0.09+0.25+0.16+0.09) = √0.75 ≈ 0.87 nm.
units.verify: 用晶圓上的參考標記陣列在不同載台位置與旋轉下重複對準，以自校正演算法分離載台誤差與標記誤差並更新校正圖；之後曝光測試晶圓，比較套刻量測的系統性殘差與預算表中各項的合計，確認未被建模的項目不超過預算的 20%。~Align repeatedly on a reference mark array at different stage positions and rotations, separate stage error from mark error with a self-calibration algorithm and update the calibration maps; then expose test wafers and compare the systematic overlay residual with the sum of the budget items, confirming that unmodelled contributions stay below 20% of the budget.
units.failure: 光柵板若因固定座應力而緩慢變形，校正圖會在幾週內過期，套刻出現平滑的低階場內圖案（放大率與旋轉項）逐漸增大，直到重新校正才消失。~If mount stress slowly deforms the grating plate, the calibration map expires within weeks and overlay develops smooth low-order intra-field patterns (magnification and rotation terms) that grow until recalibration.
units.misconception: 一次出廠校正就能讓校正圖永久有效。~A single factory calibration keeps the calibration map valid forever.

units.anchor: 主動隔振與地面振動~Active isolation and floor vibration
units.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計~Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration
units.mechanism: 計量框架與投影鏡頭由三到四組氣浮或電磁隔振器支撐，形成約 1 Hz 的低頻彈簧質量系統，地面振動在遠高於共振的頻率被衰減；主動隔振再以加速度計回授增加阻尼並壓低共振峰，同時以載台反作用力與重心移動的前饋抵消可預測的擾動。晶圓廠地板的振動等級、幫浦與空調的窄頻擾動、以及載台本身的動量轉移，都必須納入整機振動預算。~The metrology frame and projection lens rest on three or four pneumatic or electromagnetic isolators forming a spring-mass system near 1 Hz, so floor vibration well above that resonance is attenuated; active isolation adds accelerometer feedback for damping and resonance suppression, plus feedforward to cancel predictable disturbances from stage reaction forces and centre-of-gravity shifts. The fab floor vibration class, narrowband disturbances from pumps and air handling, and momentum transfer from the stages themselves all enter the whole-tool vibration budget.
units.model: 無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。若地板在 10 Hz 的振動速度為 3 µm/s，位移振幅 = v/(2πf) = 3×10⁻⁶/62.8 ≈ 48 nm，經隔振後計量框架只動 0.48 nm；但在 1.5 Hz 附近傳遞率反而放大到 1/(2.25 − 1) = 0.8，必須靠主動阻尼壓低。~An undamped isolator has transmissibility T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1): with f_n = 1 Hz the transmissibility at 10 Hz is about 1/99 ≈ 0.010. If the floor vibrates at 3 µm/s at 10 Hz, the displacement amplitude is v/(2πf) = 3×10⁻⁶/62.8 ≈ 48 nm, and the metrology frame moves only 0.48 nm after isolation; near 1.5 Hz, however, transmissibility rises to 1/(2.25 − 1) = 0.8 and must be suppressed by active damping.
units.verify: 在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較；再執行完整的掃描與步進循環，記錄框架振動與載台 MSD 的相關性，確認載台反作用力前饋能把共振附近的放大壓到預算內。~Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model; then run full scan-and-step cycles, record the correlation between frame vibration and stage MSD, and confirm that reaction-force feedforward keeps amplification near resonance within budget.
units.failure: 廠務新增的真空幫浦在 25 Hz 產生窄頻振動，雖然傳遞率只有 0.0016，但若剛好接近載台某個模態，MSD 會在該頻率出現尖峰，整批晶圓的 CD 均勻性下降而找不到機台內部原因。~A newly installed facility vacuum pump produces narrowband vibration at 25 Hz; although transmissibility is only 0.0016, if it lands near a stage mode the MSD spikes at that frequency and CD uniformity drops across whole lots with no internal cause to be found.
units.misconception: 隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。~Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency.

units.anchor: 產能模型與套刻驗收記錄~Throughput model and overlay acceptance record
units.title: 載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接~Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 載台的工程價值最後以兩個數字體現：每小時晶圓數與套刻。產能由每場的掃描時間、步進時間、整定時間與晶圓交換時間決定，雙台架構讓對準與高度量測在另一台上同時進行，把量測時間隱藏在曝光之後。驗收用同一片晶圓重複曝光量機台對自身套刻，用不同機台曝光量機台間套刻；交接文件包括校正圖版本、MA/MSD 基準曲線、熱穩定時間與所有感測器的校正日期。~The stage's engineering value is finally expressed in two numbers: wafers per hour and overlay. Throughput follows from scan time, step time, settling time and wafer exchange per field, and the dual-stage architecture lets alignment and height mapping run on the other stage so that measurement time hides behind exposure. Acceptance measures machine-to-itself overlay by re-exposing the same wafer and machine-to-machine overlay across tools; the handoff record includes calibration-map versions, MA/MSD baseline curves, thermal stabilisation time and the calibration dates of every sensor.
units.model: 每場掃描 82 ms 加步進與整定 50 ms 共 132 ms，96 個場需 12.7 s；晶圓交換與未被隱藏的開銷取 8 s，每片 20.7 s，產能 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 片/小時。若整定時間因共振問題多出 20 ms，每片多 1.9 s，產能降到 159 片/小時，下降 8.6%。~Each field takes 82 ms of scan plus 50 ms of step and settle, 132 ms in all, so 96 fields need 12.7 s; with 8 s of wafer exchange and unhidden overhead the wafer takes 20.7 s, giving 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 wafers per hour. If a resonance problem adds 20 ms of settling per field, each wafer takes 1.9 s longer and throughput falls to 159 wafers per hour, a drop of 8.6%.
units.verify: 用機台時間戳記錄每一場的掃描、步進、整定與交換時間，與模型逐項比較找出產能損失來源；對同一片晶圓做兩次曝光量測套刻，取 |mean| + 3σ 與規格比較；核對交接文件中的校正圖版本與感測器校正日期是否與機台實際狀態一致。~Log the scan, step, settle and exchange time of every field from machine timestamps and compare with the model item by item to locate throughput loss; expose the same wafer twice, measure overlay as |mean| + 3σ and compare with specification; check that the calibration-map versions and sensor calibration dates in the handoff record match the tool's actual state.
units.failure: 為了衝產能縮短整定時間，MA 看似仍在規格內，但 MSD 在每場起始端悄悄升高，CD 均勻性與良率在數週後才在電性測試中暴露，追查時已無當時的載台誤差紀錄。~Cutting settling time to chase throughput leaves MA apparently within specification while MSD creeps up at the start of every field; CD uniformity and yield only surface weeks later in electrical test, by which time the stage error logs of that period are gone.
units.misconception: 套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。~A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely.

example: 掃描與誤差預算練習：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s、光罩台 2.0 m/s、加速度 20 m/s²。加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 6.25 mm；掃描 33 mm 場加 8 mm 縫隙共 41 mm 需 82 ms；每點在縫隙下 16 ms。伺服交越 300 Hz 時 ω_c = 1885 rad/s，無前饋的加速度追蹤誤差 a/ω_c² = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm，前饋精度 99.9% 後剩 5.6 nm，這是 MA 的一個主要項。量測側：干涉儀死程 300 mm、10 mK 溫度變化給 2.8 nm，改用 3 mm 氣隙的光柵編碼器後為 0.028 nm。MA 預算取編碼器殘差 0.4、Abbe 0.3、伺服 0.5、熱 0.4、光柵 0.3 nm，RSS ≈ 0.87 nm；若保留干涉儀的 2.8 nm 空氣項，RSS 變成 √(0.75 + 7.84) ≈ 2.9 nm，超過 1.5 nm 的套刻分配，這就是光柵編碼器取代長光程干涉儀的工程理由。數值皆為教學假設。~Scan and error-budget exercise: wafer scan speed 0.5 m/s, reticle stage 2.0 m/s, acceleration 20 m/s². Reaching 0.5 m/s takes 25 ms and 6.25 mm; the 33 mm field plus 8 mm slit, 41 mm in all, takes 82 ms; each point sits under the slit for 16 ms. With a 300 Hz servo crossover, ω_c = 1885 rad/s, the acceleration tracking error without feedforward is a/ω_c² = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm, and 99.9% feedforward accuracy leaves 5.6 nm, a major MA item. On the measurement side, a 300 mm interferometer dead path with a 10 mK change gives 2.8 nm, whereas a grating encoder with a 3 mm air gap gives 0.028 nm. The MA budget with encoder residual 0.4, Abbe 0.3, servo 0.5, thermal 0.4 and grating 0.3 nm gives RSS ≈ 0.87 nm; keeping the interferometer's 2.8 nm air term instead raises the RSS to √(0.75 + 7.84) ≈ 2.9 nm, beyond a 1.5 nm overlay allocation, which is the engineering reason grating encoders replaced long-path interferometers. All numbers are teaching assumptions.
history: 1980 年代的步進機以氣浮載台與 HeNe 雷射干涉儀達到次微米定位，1990 年代步進掃描機要求光罩台與晶圓台同步運動，使 MA/MSD 成為標準規格；ASML 在 2001 年推出雙晶圓台的 TWINSCAN，把量測與曝光分開進行，2000 年代末期的 NXT 系列改用光柵編碼器量測與平衡質量，EUV 的 NXE 系列在真空中採用磁浮平面馬達載台。這些架構的公開原理可在 ASML 與編碼器廠商的技術文件中找到，本課不涉及任何專有控制參數。~Steppers of the 1980s reached sub-micrometre positioning with air-bearing stages and HeNe laser interferometers; 1990s step-and-scan tools required synchronised reticle and wafer motion, making MA/MSD a standard specification. ASML introduced the dual-wafer-stage TWINSCAN in 2001 to separate measurement from exposure, the NXT series of the late 2000s moved to grating-encoder metrology and balance masses, and the EUV NXE series uses magnetically levitated planar-motor stages in vacuum. The public principles of these architectures appear in ASML and encoder-maker technical documents; this course involves no proprietary control parameters.
